tests.name: Live staging: feedback, village lookup, mic
tests.assertion: Staging app against https://staging.kissansahyog.com: (a) a KSTEST feedback from /grievance shows the success state, its POST carries Origin https://localhost and the response has Access-Control-Allow-Origin https://localhost; (b) /post step 3: typing a village gives known-village suggestions, and the typed-village map lookup (LocationControl → live /geocode) returns a place, with the app CORS; (c) the mic on /search is shown if and only if the live /transcribe says configured:true (value recorded)
tests.notes:
feedback: success; village: 2 known match(es) for "Band", lookup Surkhi चुनें
